justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/MethodAttributeAppender.java:148-230 and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/MethodAttributeAppenderForInstrumentedMethodTest.java, .../MethodAttributeAppenderForInstrumentedMethodOtherTest.java. The enum has only two variants (EXCLUDING_RECEIVER, INCLUDING_RECEIVER) plus a trivial make() and one apply() method with a small receiver hook; all logic is focused on writing method, parameter, return, exception, and optional receiver annotations. The tests cover exactly those two branches and factory identity, which indicates a cohesive, narrowly scoped class rather than insufficient modularization.
